SIMPLE BY DESIGN

Keep your
training close.

Your routines and session history stay in this app’s local storage. No account, no developer-operated cloud sync, and no analytics SDK.

YouTube handles embedded video data under Google’s policies. Device backups may include your app data, depending on your settings.
